## Structure

Workshop sessions are organized by type, with individual sessions within each type folder using the naming convention:
`[Session-Name]-[MM-DD-YYYY]/`
page_texts.3:
[strategy/workshops/sessions/README.md#example-structure]

### Example Structure

```text
sessions/
├── roadmap-planning/
│   ├── Technology-Roadmap-11-15-2025/
│   │   ├── inputs/
│   │   ├── outputs/
│   │   └── README.md
│   └── README.md
└── README.md           # This file
```

## Session Structure

Each individual workshop session contains:
page_texts.7:
[strategy/workshops/sessions/README.md#inputs]

### `inputs/`

Pre-workshop materials including:

- Requirements documents
- Current state assessments
- Stakeholder analysis
- Background materials
- Agenda and logistics
page_texts.8:
[strategy/workshops/sessions/README.md#outputs]

### `outputs/`

Workshop deliverables including:

- Decision records
- Action plans
- Architecture diagrams
- Meeting minutes
- Follow-up plans
